source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Large tree in riparian sites; no species maximum height in this treatment
morphology_documented.leaves: (7–)9–17 leaflets; lateral leaflets often falcate, asymmetrical at base, with prominent teeth; mostly glabrous upper midrib
morphology_documented.buds: Usually brown or occasionally yellowish brown; valvate bud scales (key group)
morphology_documented.bark: Ridged or with appressed to small exfoliating plate-like scales
morphology_documented.fruit: Fruit 25–80 mm long × 12–25 mm diameter, elongated and generally not laterally flattened; pointed at both ends; sweet edible kernel; thin husk with winged seams
morphology_documented.habitat: Stream bottoms and slopes; frequently cultivated

source_scope_note: Historical species treatments and explicitly identified genus/key characteristics only; missing morphology not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora mentions named cultivars, which are not interchangeable with wild-source native conservation plant material
Annual pecan cultivars do not prove local wild occurrence; BONAP county verification remains independent
preservation: Additive record only, original species and photo/credits/gallery unchanged
